work.scenario: You are in a team meeting discussing the progress of a new software project. You need to talk about updating project status, developing new features, and fixing bugs.
key_phrases: Kita perlu mengemaskini status projek ini.
Pasukan kami sedang membangunkan ciri-ciri baru.
Ada masalah teknikal yang perlu diselesaikan segera.

life.scenario: You're helping your friend set up a new smartphone or troubleshoot an internet connection issue at home. You also recommend a new app that is easy to use.
key_phrases: Aplikasi ni senang guna, tak payah pening-pening.
Kena update sistem operasi telefon ni.

tech.scenario: You are attending a tech conference where speakers are discussing the importance of digital transformation for businesses and the need to innovate with user-friendly solutions.
key_phrases: Transformasi digital adalah kunci kejayaan syarikat.
Kita perlu menginovasi produk yang mesra pengguna.
Pendigitalan proses kerja dapat meningkatkan kecekapan.
